LESSON: LINES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Lines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Lines. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-073.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 73]]

From your pupil's book (page 73)

GEOMETRY LINES Week 11 Lesson 4 Straight and curved lines Activity Identify straight and curved lines

Work to do 1. Name places with curved lines _____________ _____________ _____________ 2. Name places with straight lines _____________ _____________ _____________ 61

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-136.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 136]]

From your pupil's book (page 136)

GEOMETRY LINES Week 11 Lesson 2 Making straight lines

Work to do Use plasticine or clay to make straight lines

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-137.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 137]]

From your pupil's book (page 137)

TERM 2 Week 11 Lesson 3 Drawing straight lines

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Lines means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Lines.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Lines
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
